entry.onboarding.title: An internal app for staff
entry.onboarding.intro: {app} is an internal app for the shop's staff, not for customers.
entry.onboarding.whyTitle: Why a Zalo login is needed
entry.onboarding.why: The app uses your Zalo account to recognise you without a password. Then you read the staff notice and enter the pairing code the store manager gives you.
entry.onboarding.keptId: Your Zalo id in this app and your Zalo display name.
entry.onboarding.keptPhone: Your phone number only if you link it yourself later under Me.
entry.failed.title: Could not connect
entry.failed.body: Check the network connection, then try again.
entry.noNotice.title: No staff notice yet
entry.noNotice.body: The shop has not published its staff notice yet, so pairing cannot start. Please tell the store manager.
entry.notice.intro: Please read the notice below. You can use the app only after you agree.
entry.notice.updated: The staff notice has a new version. Please read it again before you agree.
entry.notice.again: Please read and agree to this notice to keep using the app.
entry.notice.failed: Could not record that. Please try again.
entry.pairing.title: Enter the pairing code
entry.pairing.body: Ask the store manager for a 6-digit pairing code. It is valid for 10 minutes and works once.
entry.pairing.label: Pairing code
entry.pairing.refused: The code is wrong or has expired. Check it, or ask the manager for a new one.
entry.pairing.wait: Too many wrong codes. Try again in {time}.
entry.pairing.waitOver: You can enter a code again.
entry.refused.title: You declined
entry.refused.body: You can use the app only after you agree to the staff notice. You can read it again and agree at any time.
entry.refused.contactFallback: If you have questions, ask your store manager in person.

profile.legal.title: Legal
profile.consent.title: Agreement to the staff notice
profile.consent.body: You can withdraw your agreement at any time. The app then stops recognising you until you agree again and pair with a new code.
profile.withdraw.title: Withdraw your agreement?
profile.withdraw.body: The app will stop recognising you. To use it again, you agree again and enter a new pairing code. Your agreement to receive notifications, if any, stays as it is.
profile.withdraw.failed: Could not withdraw. Please try again.
phone.title: Link your phone number
phone.purpose: The phone number lets the store manager reach you about work when needed.
phone.optional: Linking is optional: without it you use the app as usual.
phone.prompt: When you choose Continue, Zalo asks whether you agree to share your phone number. You can refuse.
